newsitem.title: USA: Outlook Group taps Baksha as president.
newsitem.headline: Outlook Group taps Baksha as president.

text.p: Outlook Group Corp said Thursday it named Joseph Baksha to the position of president and chief operating officer, effective January 1.

Baksha will assume responsibility for all of the company's operations in the graphics and packaging businesses. David Erdmann will continue as chairman and chief executive officer, with responsibilities including strategy, acquisitions and managing the company's Outlook Foods Inc subsidiary, which is being divested, as previously reported.
Baksha joined Outlook Group in May 1996 as president of the company's packaging operations.
Outlook Group is a graphic services and packaging company that offers an array of related services including specialty printing, converting, packaging and distribution.
